item_short_desc: Gear up with Rothco’s Accent Pocket Fatigue Shorts. Featuring a solid base color and accent camouflage trim, these cargo shorts are the perfect combination of form and function ideal for everyday wear. Made from a soft yet durable 55% cotton / 45% polyester blend, these camo cargo shorts offer comfort and durability for various activities. With 2 large capacity cargo pockets, 2 rear button-down pockets, and 2 front slash pockets, these shorts provide ample storage space for your EDC essentials.
description: Gear up with Rothco’s Accent Pocket Fatigue Shorts. Featuring a solid base color and accent camouflage trim, these cargo shorts are the perfect combination of form and function ideal for everyday wear. Made from a soft yet durable 55% cotton / 45% polyester blend, these camo cargo shorts offer comfort and durability for various activities. With 2 large capacity cargo pockets, 2 rear button-down pockets, and 2 front slash pockets, these shorts provide ample storage space for your EDC essentials. The zipper fly with adjustable pull tabs on the waist ensures a secure fit. Designed with a relaxed fit, these durable shorts offer extreme comfortability for extended wear. Whether you're running errands, enjoying outdoor activities, or simply relaxing, these camo accent shorts are a versatile addition to your wardrobe. Rothco stands out as the leader in camouflage clothing and accessories. With a rich heritage spanning over 7 decades, we have honed our expertise in crafting durable and effective camouflage gear. Our extensive range of products, including apparel, bags, and gear, showcases a diverse selection of camouflage, with over 35 patterns available! From outdoor enthusiasts and active-duty personnel, to skate and fashion, Rothco is the go-to brand for camo.
